description: Operator-asserted fallback allowlist for the repo_in_approved_orgs verification check. Used ONLY when the live Wave approved-orgs source is unreachable (see README 'Known limitation: Wave-approval verification'). Each entry is a MANUAL assertion by the named operator - a resulting 'pass' is NOT independently verifiable by a third party the way this project's on-chain attestations are. Every entry MUST carry repo / assertedBy / assertedAt / evidenceUrl; a bare repo string is rejected.

entries.note: This project's own on-chain registry contract repository, in the Proofowl GitHub org the asserting maintainer controls. Seed entry, not a Wave-approved third-party contribution.

This repository, at its real GitHub path Proofowl/backend (the local folder is 'proofowl-backend'; the earlier seed entry used 'proofowl/proofowl-backend' which does not resolve). Corrected so pipeline discovery and repo_in_approved_orgs both target the real repo. Seed entry asserted by its own maintainer, not a Wave approval.
